<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-GW-010</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Gateway</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Gateway log</b></div></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>storage full — dropping new events until the backlog drains</span></div>

## Why it happens

The gateway stores readings while SENTIENT is unreachable: by default up to 10 files of 10,000 records, 1 GB at most, kept for 7 days. Once full, new readings are dropped; stored ones are kept and sent first.

## Fix it

- Restore the connection to SENTIENT; the queue drains by itself.
- For longer outages, raise the storage limits in the gateway's **General** configuration and make sure the disk has room.
- Poll slower where fast values are not needed.

## Check that it worked

The log no longer shows the message, and the backlog shrinks.
